spec.name: hecs-r1.v1

data.exploration: uniform actions in [-1, 1] held for 1..=8 steps

ecs.primitive: native K1 (elpis_ecsg_k1), one state per level; LEARN only (H stays 0: exact G1)
ecs.input: [z0, z1, b, sel0, sel1, 1]; target z'_k

encoders.temporal_shared: none: the window's last lower latent (window 1)
encoders.hierarchical_distinct: affine 4 -> 2, two most predictable whitened directions of the window (linear one-tick predictor residual vs input covariance)
encoders.action_pooling: mean of the lower actions over the stride

measurements.probes: ridge (1e-3) linear probe, latent -> s and f at the window-end time; fit on train, NMSE on test
measurements.attractors: free run at b = 0 from a 5 x 5 grid on [-2, 2]^2 for 200 steps

planning.goal: observation rendered from (s_goal, f_goal), f_goal drawn from the second factor's stationary law

validity_law.instances: every DEV (calibration, run) or QUAL world instance, both worlds; FLAT_N36 level 1
validity_law.C_ECS_ADEQUACY: no one-step divergence and (constant - ecs) >= V1C_MIN_CAPTURE * (constant - linear)
validity_law.floor: tr(P Q P^T) / 2 / held-out normalizer; Q = R diag(slow_noise^2, (1 - rho^2) second_std^2) R^T + n^2 I + n^2 A A^T, A = R diag(1, rho) R^T
validity_law.linear: z' ~ [z0, z1, b, 1], least squares on the training partition only, scored on the held-out one-step examples the ECS is scored on

stop_laws: DEV calibration: the smallest grid budget at which V1 (A, B and C) holds in every DEV instance; none: TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV, stop
DEV run at the chosen budget: any of V1-V5 fails: TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV, stop; DEV hypothesis values are non-binding
DEV valid: QUAL is authorized and runs once on QUAL seeds at the DEV budget; its disposition is final
QUAL: any of V1-V5 fails: TASK_INVALID; else OUTCOME_A..D
EXPERIMENTAL integration (noncanonical, Rust controller over the K1 C ABI) is authorized only by QUAL OUTCOME_A
no gate, threshold, world parameter, budget, seed or condition changes after DEV data exist
